name: A Little Bitty Christmas
source:
A fun and whimsical tale about a dog finding their owner before Christmas. With the help of some unlikely but kind dogs along the way.  

[From [url=https://breezy-the-sleazy.itch.io/a-little-bitty-christmas]itch.io[/url]]

一个关于一只狗在圣诞节前找到主人的有趣而异想天开的故事。一路上有一些不太可能但善良的狗的帮助。

[来自[url=https://breezy-the-sleazy.itch.io/a-little-bitty-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
